cover.title: 5 free ways to speed up Windows 11
cover.sub: Built in, no extra apps needed

slides.title: Disable startup apps
slides.body: Ctrl + Shift + Esc, then Startup apps. Select an app you don't need and click Disable.

slides.title: Install Windows updates
slides.body: Settings > Windows Update > Check for updates. Updates can fix bugs that slow your PC.

slides.title: Turn on Storage Sense
slides.body: Settings > System > Storage > Storage Sense. It deletes temporary files automatically.

slides.title: Uninstall unused apps
slides.body: Settings > Apps > Installed apps. Sort by size and remove what you never open.

slides.title: Adjust for best performance
slides.body: Search "Adjust the appearance and performance of Windows" and pick Adjust for best performance.
